primitives.name: Nickel Suppression Slot Share
primitives.verbatim_quote: Nickel "suppression" of slot targets: it *raises* slot share +6.18 pp (personnel matching).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'+6.18\\ \\text{pp}': 'Absolute increase in slot receiver target percentage in nickel packages'}
primitives.assumptions: Receiver targeting follows a multinomial distribution conditioned on defensive personnel groupings.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down in pass-happy offenses where the nickel package becomes the base defense, eliminating the contrast.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI matchup probability updates where defensive adjustments (e.g., nickel) alter offensive play selection probabilities via conditional expectation.
layer2.telemetry: Difference in average slot target rate between games with and without nickel personnel.
